signature: Right-turning drivers from the south approach vs pedestrians in the east crosswalk
summary: 4 close calls across all three cameras where a right-turning driver entered the east crosswalk while a pedestrian was in it or about to step in. Worst margin 0.7 s. In 3 of 4 the pedestrian was already crossing when the car arrived.

recommendations.name: Leading Pedestrian Interval
recommendations.why: In 3 of 4 events the pedestrian had already started crossing when the turning car arrived (EV_A1_0023, EV_A1_0060, EV_A3_0026). A head start makes pedestrians visible before turns begin.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

recommendations.name: Crosswalk Visibility Enhancements
recommendations.why: 1 event(s) involved a pedestrian hidden from the driver (EV_A1_0060): a parked van on the east leg blocked the sight line to the crosswalk.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

signature: Northbound left turns accepting short gaps in southbound through traffic
summary: 3 close calls where a northbound driver turned left across southbound traffic with too little time. Median margin 1.4 s; all with permissive left turns.

recommendations.name: Dedicated Left- and Right-Turn Lanes at Intersections
recommendations.why: All 3 events (EV_B1_0025, EV_B1_0061, EV_B2_0039) involve a left-turning car waiting in the through lane and then accepting a short gap; a dedicated turn lane and protected phase separate the decision from through traffic.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

recommendations.name: Reduced Left-Turn Conflict Intersections
recommendations.why: Repeated left-turn vs oncoming conflicts (EV_B1_0025, EV_B1_0061, EV_B2_0039) are the conflict type these designs remove.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

signature: Right-turning drivers crossing the northbound bike lane in front of cyclists (right hook)
summary: 3 right-hook close calls: drivers overtook a northbound cyclist and turned right across the bike lane. No catalog countermeasure in our verified FHWA list maps to this conflict yet (Bicycle Lanes URL not found on the FHWA site); flagged for engineer review.

signature: Night mid-block crossings vs fast eastbound cars
summary: 3 night-time close calls at the unsignalized mid-block crossing. 3 of 3 cars were above the 25 mph limit; the crossing sits in a gap between streetlights.

recommendations.name: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
recommendations.why: Pedestrians crossed at an uncontrolled mid-block location in all 3 events (EV_D1_0027, EV_D1_0062, EV_D2_0035); drivers gave no sign of expecting them.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

recommendations.name: Lighting
recommendations.why: All 3 events happened at night with the pedestrian between streetlight pools (EV_D1_0027, EV_D1_0062, EV_D2_0035).
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

recommendations.name: Medians and Pedestrian Refuge Islands in Urban and Suburban Areas
recommendations.why: Pedestrians had to judge both directions of fast traffic in one go (EV_D1_0027, EV_D1_0062, EV_D2_0035); a refuge splits the crossing.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.
